name: Pulselens
summary: Product analytics for a mobile app, with a live dot globe of users and funnels that drain as you add steps
about: An eight-page product analytics dashboard for a grocery delivery app on iOS and Android, in white with coral and indigo. People in the app right now ping on a dot globe you can drag, and funnel steps are liquid tanks that drain when you add or move a step. Retention cohorts, a live events explorer, user profiles with a session timeline, A/B experiments with live confidence, alerts and settings all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the pill bar: Overview, Funnels, Retention, Events, Users, Experiments, Alerts or Settings
On the overview, drag the globe or tap a city to turn to it; pause the live feed or switch the range to 7 or 30 days
In Funnels, add, move or remove steps and change the window or platform; the tanks drain to the new numbers, then save the funnel
Tap a cohort row in Retention to compare its curve, and filter Events by platform, country or version, then open an event
Pick a person in Users and tap a session bar to replay what they did, or add them to a cohort
Start, stop or ship experiments, add alert rules with a line to watch, and set channels and quiet hours
Press Ctrl+K to jump to any page, person or action, and reset the demo data in Settings
